author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I just discovered Claude Code default to use 1 hour cache write, which is 2x the input tokens cost.   For a lot of turns, using the 5 min cache, which is only 1.25x cost, is good enough.   And for the majority of turns, refresh cache twice to keep it warm for 15 minutes only cost 1.45x

I wonder why Anthropic neglect to optimize the Claude Code input cache logics to save the users some money.

Here is my conspiracy theory, they need good revenue number preparing for the IPO.

author.name: Christopher Fortin
author.headline: Founder, SVP Strategic Development at 5Seams, Inc.

comments.text: Like they bank computer, it knows who it works for. All these frontier models are suddenly 5 year olds that force you to do everything manually when it comest to resource budgeting. People are going to give up some frontier and edge capability to know whatever they built and deployed runs at the scale of hardware they bought definitively and or without some insane token/API bill showing up when the new AWS turns up the bill/crank on their captive customers to blow out the quarter. Open models and private hosting will have a place.
